description: Returns the entry catalog (id, kind, title, tags, moduleName)—no payload. Supports kind/moduleName/tags filters and pagination (limit max 200). Unlinked entries lack moduleName; run validate after edits. For typed horizontal views use get-slice.

kind.description: Filter by exact kind, e.g. http-endpoint

projectId.description: Required. Call list-projects first (query by workspace folder name) and pass the matching projectId. Never omit. default-project is forbidden.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring in title, kind, or tags

tags.description: Filter entries having any of these tags

name: list-entries
title: List Entries
